items.example: She's really interesting — I want to know her better.
Mark is intelligent but very quiet in big groups.
I'm really kind. I always help my friends.
My sister is very talkative — she speaks all the time.
Everyone in the group is friendly and helpful.
Tom is funny — people often laugh at his jokes.
My boss is serious, but he's a very good manager.
The film was long and boring.
He's quiet, but he loves being with people.
It was unkind to say that to your best friend.
I'm not very friendly in the morning.
Have you got one real best friend?
Bridget has got thirty-five online friends.
We hardly ever meet, but we keep in touch.
Real friends tell each other about personal things.
